summary: Design a microlearning pilot with content maps, nudges, scenarios, and measurement plans. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: Microlearning ecosystem design helps L&D leaders, HR business partners, and digital adoption leads connect brief learning to everyday work. It supports turning isolated content into a coordinated pilot through audience mapping, content sequencing, and spaced retrieval, with nudges and scenarios supporting practice. Participants also plan measures for engagement and application and review introductory xAPI and Kirkpatrick evaluation approaches.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape employee learning or help people apply new skills during daily work. It suits you if you need to turn isolated short content into a coordinated program across teams, learning channels, and business priorities.
modules: Nudges and the Fogg Behavior Model
prerequisites: Prior experience in learning and development, employee communications, HR, digital adoption, or change enablement is recommended. You should bring familiarity with at least one workplace learning or change initiative. Coding is not required; spreadsheet access is useful for the measurement exercises.
